recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — Crevier already provides a CPRA-compliant opt-out entry point: the footer 'Your California Privacy Choices' link routes to /ccpa-requests/, a ComplyAuto-hosted request portal handling sale/share opt-out. NOT a standalone link gap.

Offer Details and Disclaimers

title: Offer headline figures rendered as images may lack alt text (WCAG 1.1.1)
quote:
NEW SPECIALS
Offer Details and Disclaimers

Open Details Modal
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The Specials page renders each offer's headline figure as an image with no extractable text/alt during the crawl. BMW requires WCAG Level AA, including 1.1.1 Non-text Content (all images must have text alternatives). If these offer images carry no alt text they fail WCAG 1.1.1 and degrade screen-reader access. Reviewer should inspect the image elements for alt attributes and add descriptive alt text (including the offer amount and model) where missing. Visual/markup verification required; cannot be confirmed from extracted text alone.

title: '$X off MSRP' loyalty offers use MSRP as the savings reference price
quote: Available Loyalty Offer of $5,000 off MSRP on select new 2026 740i Sedan models (consists of $4,000 BMW of North America, LLC contribution plus $1,000 loyalty contribution from your BMW Center). Must take delivery by June 30, 2026.
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The offers express savings as '$X off MSRP' and are conditional loyalty incentives (qualified customers who leased/financed a BMW through BMW FS in the last 12 months). On the positive side, each disclaimer states expiration/delivery dates (June 29/30, 2026), itemizes the BMW NA vs. dealer-center contribution split, and discloses the loyalty qualification, which substantially addresses the substantiation and dating concerns under criterion 5. Residual advisory: MSRP is a manufacturer-suggested figure, not necessarily a genuine prior selling price, so 'off MSRP' framing should remain clearly tied to MSRP (which it is here) rather than implying a reduction from an actual transacted price. Confirm the loyalty conditions are equally visible wherever the dollar-off figure appears. Low legal risk given dates and itemized substantiation are present.
